items.why: Volatility jumps as the S&P 500 and Dow enter correction and the Nasdaq wipes out its 2026 gain.
Nvidia and AMD extend declines as the AI trade melts down, with chip names leading the sell-off.
Nvidia is having its worst week since 2018 as investors weigh CEO transition fallout despite strong Q3 results.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.

market_note: Nasdaq futures are down 4.66% and S&P futures down 2.93% as the AI sell-off continues.
summary: Stocks are selling off hard, with the S&P 500 and Dow in correction and the Nasdaq wiping out its 2026 gain as the AI sell-off deepens. It is shaping up to be the worst week since liberation day.
